prose.subject: Payment Reminder: Invoice INV-89766
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is a quick, friendly reminder that invoice INV-89766 is due. The total amount is 2450.71 USDC.

Please ensure the payment is sent to our standard wallet address: 0xcfd2e5119b420cbb34451a6ecc48a3251283040b

Let us know once the transaction has been initiated so we can confirm receipt on our end. If you have already sent the payment, please disregard this note.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this!

Best regards,
Larchmont Security Billing Team
